text: The Hansen Global Forest Change dataset recorded tree-cover loss within the property in 2021. The total area of tree-cover loss was approximately 81.3 hectares, which represents about 2.23% of the asset's total area. This observation was corroborated by the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference data, which agreed on 98% of the event area. The tree-cover loss occurred within a planted forest context, specifically within a plantation of Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. It's important to note that this data does not specify the cause of the loss or whether it was legal or illegal.
